feature: P5-TB-RANGE keyboard deletion across three or more compatible HWPX textbox paragraphs
supported: An ordinary top-level HWPX textbox with at most 64 paragraphs. Every crossed pair must share the exact paragraph shape and style and pass the existing engine proof. The first and last paragraphs can have mixed character runs; surviving runs and language slots are checked. The range is deleted in one history step.
refused: Different paragraph shape or style in any crossed paragraph, nested controls or hidden fields, active IME, HWP5, empty or overlong merged result, and cross-paragraph replacement.

checks.focusReleaseWasm: 3 PASS (adjacent, three paragraphs, incompatible middle refusal including byte-identical export)

nativeX11.acceptance: python3 scripts/tests/native-ibus-session.py --out <session> -- python3 scripts/tests/native-stage3a-p5.py --out <result> --fixtures <fixtures> --cases P5-TB-RANGE P5.5 --xdotool @XDOTOOL@ --ibus @IBUS@
nativeX11.independentReopen: HWPX package XML and other non-preview entries match outside the edit. A separate RHWP load confirms Boain with retained bold/italic runs, original paragraph formatting, surrounding text, and owner geometry. The Release app reopens the published file and selects the retained text.

otherPlatforms: Wayland, Windows and macOS: NOT RUN.
